verdict.rationale: TaxJar documents product-level taxability through a `product_tax_code` on each line item, but its own client library says these rules cover only "a subset of product categories." Nothing in the pack shows SaaS or digital-goods handling, state-by-state differences for those categories, bundle treatment, or visible research behind any determination. Missing for 10: evidence of SaaS/digital-goods tax codes and per-state rules, bundled-offering handling, visible research or rationale per determination, independent or hands-on corroboration of accuracy.
